description: Ask a follow-up grounded in one public fragment. Remote MCP callers pass fragment_id from search_cassie_hour_fragments; browser callers may have the current fragment pre-bound. Returns the fragment-grounded response and continuation metadata; no private manuscript text is read. No authentication required. Search again if an ID is unavailable; do not guess one.

conversation_id.description: Optional conversation_id returned by an earlier successful concierge/fragment response. Supply it only to continue that conversation; otherwise omit it.

fragment_id.description: Required canonical fragment ID from search_cassie_hour_fragments for remote MCP calls; browser may prebind this value.

language.description: Optional response-language tag, up to 16 characters; defaults to en. Use a supported tag such as en or tr; unsupported values may fall back to the service default.

page_url.description: Optional canonical fragment page URL for continuation context; use the URL returned by public fragment search, not an arbitrary page.

previous_response_id.description: Optional previous_response_id returned by the immediately preceding successful response in this conversation. Pair it with its conversation_id; otherwise omit it.

question.description: Required natural-language question or reader interest (1–1000 characters). For evaluate_cassie_hour_fit state the reader's preferences; for get_verified_recommendation state the recommendation need; for ask_cassie_hour ask a supported public Cassie Hour question.

name: continue_from_this_fragment
title: Continue from a Cassie Hour fragment
